marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind south 10 to 15 knots becoming light near midnight then
becoming south 15 early Monday morning. Flurries this evening and Monday. Temperatures near minus 2. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
